hits.title: Leadership Shift at Olipop: A Strategic Pivot for the Functional Soda Giant
hits.snippet: ## Main Facts: A Strategic Succession The announcement, made official on August 12, 2026, marks the end of an era for the brand’s founding leadership while simultaneously initiating a new chapter in its corporate maturity. Ben Goodwin, who has served as the public face and strategic architect of Olipop since its inception, will step back from the day-to-day administrative burdens of the CEO office. Goodwin’s new designation allows him to focus exclusively on product development, long-term scientific research into prebiotics, and the creative pipeline—areas where he has historically provided the most value. To replace him, the board has appointed Christian Patiño Webb. Webb arrives with an extensive pedigree in the consumer-packaged goods (CPG) sector, most notably his recent tenure at Electrolit and a significant background at Unilever, where he served as vice president of marketing for SmartyPants Vitamins. Functional soda brand Olipop has announced via a social media post that it has named Christian Patiño Webb to be its new chief executive officer, and that founder Ben Goodwin will move into the role of executive chairman and head of innovation for the company. Olipop believes adding Patiño Webb as the CEO will bring operational depth and leadership experience to help advance the company’s long-term vision. Meanwhile, Goodwin will transition into his new position with the company, continuing to shape Olipop’s long-term vision, drive innovation and help define the direction of the company.
